title: Sentinel-2 TrueColor Subdaily (TEST)
description: TEST COLLECTION -- not for production use. Exercises the dps-output-discover Lambda end to end: routing, relocation into ProgramData/, and the veda_discover DAG trigger. Discovers from ProgramData/Sentinel-2/TestTrueColor/, shared with its daily counterpart -- the two are told apart by filename_regex exactly as sentinel2-truecolor-daily and -subdaily are. The prefix deliberately does NOT begin with 'TrueColor': sentinel2-truecolor-daily declares the slash-less prefix ProgramData/Sentinel-2/TrueColor, so any TrueColor* folder is claimed by that collection too. Matches unmerged scenes, which keep a full acquisition timestamp and end Z.tif. No datetime_range, so each item carries a point datetime rather than a day bracket. The dps-output-discover routing table must list this collection and declare that same dest_prefix. Safe to delete once the pipeline is verified.
